name: email-html-editor
description: Generic HTML/text editor with a live composed preview for the email notification content classes (EmailLayout, EmailTemplateStandard, EmailTemplate). Placed once per class's detail view with different Input bindings — see CLAUDE.md's Email templates section for the layout/standard-body/template composition it mirrors. Subject is plain metadata, not HTML — edit it via Appfarm's normal field editor, not here. Action is contextual to the record this instance is placed on — no id parameter.
